## Problem

When using `--group-by release` (or `--group-by milestone`), changelog sections were ordered by when the first item in each release was last updated, not by release version. This caused older releases to appear before newer ones when any item in the older release was updated after the newer release was created.

## Root Cause

`groupSectionsByMetadata` iterated through items sorted by `updated_at` descending and grouped them via a `Map`, whose insertion order determined section order. If an item in an older release was recently updated (e.g. to fix metadata), its release section was inserted first.

## Fix

Sort sections by version heading descending after grouping, with the fallback heading (`Unreleased`) always first. Version segments are compared numerically when they parse as integers, lexicographically otherwise. The `v` prefix is stripped before comparison.

## Reproduction

```ts
const items = [
  { id: '1', title: 'Old item', status: 'closed', release: 'v1.0', updated_at: '2026-05-24T10:00:00Z' },
  { id: '2', title: 'New item', status: 'closed', release: 'v2.0', updated_at: '2026-05-24T09:00:00Z' },
];
// item '1' has a later updated_at so v1.0 section appeared before v2.0
createChangelog({ items, groupBy: 'release' });
```
